claim.text: Applying iterative magnitude pruning to the Deep Fingerprinting (DF) model for the Walkie–Talkie defense scenario reduces the number of trainable parameters from 3,981,476 to 816,088 after 9 pruning rounds.
After 9 pruning rounds, applying iterative magnitude pruning to the Deep Fingerprinting (DF) model for the Walkie–Talkie defense scenario maintains the classification accuracy at approximately 49%.
The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis can be used to find a smaller subnetwork of the Deep Fingerprinting (DF) model that achieves comparable performance.
